newsitem.title: USA: N.American Mortgage June loan applications up.
newsitem.headline: N.American Mortgage June loan applications up.

text.p: North American Mortgage Co said Monday its loan applications for June rose 18 percent to $1.3 billion from $1.1 billion in June 1996.

Loan fundings for the latest month were $839 million, a nine percent increase over June 1996 fundings of $768 million. The June 1997 totals include $89 million of loan applications and $48 million of fundings from the company's subprime lending program, it said.
Refinancings represented 25 percent of total fundings and 29 percent of total applications for June 1997, it said.
As of June 30, it said company-owned loan servicing portfolio was $12.7 billion, some eight percent lower than its June 1996 portfolio of $13.8 billion.
The servicing portfolio had a weighted average coupon of 7.90 percent at June 30, and the portfolio's delinquency rate, including foreclosures, was 3.42 percent, it said.

North American Mortgage originates, acquires, sells and services mortgage loans which are principally first-lien mortgage loans secured by single-family residences. It operates 104 production offices in 31 states.
